findings.body: The only registry test always sets XDG_CONFIG_HOME on Unix, so it never verifies the explicitly required ~/.config fallback. Removing or breaking that fallback in machine.py would leave this test passing, and no other test asserts the registry location. Add a case through the real Forge command with XDG_CONFIG_HOME unset and HOME isolated, then assert that the checkout is recorded in ~/.config/forge/repos.
findings.title: Not done: test the default ~/.config registry location
